TileDataHelp: Choose a Web API, RSS/Atom feed or local data file. Updates run while Start is visible. Connections and credentials are encrypted for this Windows user and excluded from exports.
TileDataSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the saved credential. Changing the server clears it unless you enter a new value.
TileDataInvalid: Check the connection: use HTTPS, loopback HTTP, or an existing local file.
HoldToCreateFolder: Hold to create or add to a folder
LayoutEditingHint: Click tiles to select; drag a selection to move it. Apps stay closed.
SelectionDoesNotFit: The selection does not fit here. Drop it on open space or move it using the group menu.
SettingsStartButton: Open ReStart when I click the Windows Start button
ErrorHotkeyInUse: Ctrl+Alt+Space is in use. Open ReStart from the notification area.
ErrorUnhandled: ReStart encountered an error and will close. Your saved layout is preserved.
SettingsShortcutHelp: Windows shortcuts such as Win+E and Win+D remain available. You can also use Ctrl+Alt+Space or the notification area.
SettingsAutostart: Start when I sign in to Windows
ErrorWindowsKeyCapture: Could not capture the Windows key:
SettingsWindowsKey: Open ReStart with a single Windows key press
ErrorInvalidUrl: Enter an http or https URL.
StatusExported: Exported. The file includes launch targets and local paths.
SettingsWallpaper: Use the desktop wallpaper as the background
SettingsLayoutHelp: Positions, sizes and folders are saved automatically. Hover over a tile center for about one second, then drop to create a folder.
SettingsLanguageHelp: The language changes when you save. App names and your custom labels are preserved.
SettingsCloseOnDeactivate: Close when switching to another app
SearchHint: Search with part of an app name.
ErrorFutureLayout: This layout uses a newer format and is protected from changes.
ConfirmImport: Replace your current pins? Imported tiles include launch targets. Only use files you trust.
SettingsPrivacy: No ads or usage reporting. Installed apps and shortcuts are read locally on this PC.
EmptyGroups: + Create a group and pin apps
StatusCatalogReady: {0} apps  ·  Type to search  ·  Esc to close
ConfirmDeleteGroup: Delete “{0}” and its pins? The apps themselves will remain installed.
ConfirmPower: {0} this PC? Save your work first.
ErrorLayoutRead: Could not read the layout. The original file is preserved. {0}
ErrorStartupExecutable: Use the portable ReStart.exe to register startup.
ErrorStartupPathLength: The startup path is too long. Move ReStart to a shorter path.
PreviewAutostartHelp: Preview mode does not change Windows startup registration.
StartupBackgroundHelp: Starts in the notification area when you sign in. Use the shortcut to open Start.
StatusScriptAdded: Tile added. Close settings to see it.
ScriptAuthoringHelp: Build your own live tiles with JavaScript. Create a sample and edit tile.js in Notepad. Saved changes appear on the next refresh.
ScriptCapabilitiesHelp: Scripts receive the time, language, settings and previous state. Network, file, Node.js, DOM and CLR APIs are not exposed. See the tile development guide linked in the README.
ErrorScriptManifestInvalid: Invalid tile manifest (version 1, title 1–80, refreshSeconds 1–3600, settings JSON ≤8192 characters).
ErrorScriptFrameInvalid: Invalid tile frame. Check text lengths, #RRGGBB colors, progress 0–1 and state JSON ≤8192 characters.
ErrorAppCommandUnavailable: This command is no longer available for this app.
ErrorAppCommand: Could not run the app command:
MigrationNone: No recorded upgrade. New settings use the current format.
MigrationReadOnly: These settings were created by a newer version and are read-only.
MigrationRollbackHelp: To roll back, exit ReStart, keep a copy of the current layout, and restore the matching backup as layout.json. An older app cannot edit a newer schema.
UpdateUpToDate: This version is up to date for the selected channel.
UpdateNoReleases: No complete release is available for this architecture and channel.
UpdateRateLimited: GitHub's request limit was reached. Try again later.
UpdateNetworkError: The update service could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
UpdateInvalidResponse: The release response could not be verified. Open Releases to check manually.
UpdateNoAutoInstall: The app checks for updates only. Download and extract the release manually; the app does not replace itself.
UpdatePrivacy: Update checks contact api.github.com with the app version. No API key or account is required. No app list, layout or usage history is sent.
UpdatesDisabledInPreview: Network checks are disabled in preview mode.
LicenseChoose: Select a license or notice to read and copy.
SettingsStartAccentHelp: Applies to the dark Start surface. Classic colored tiles share the selected accent unless you choose an individual tile color.
ErrorInvalidColor: Enter a color as #RRGGBB, for example #0078D7.
UpdateServiceUnavailable: The public release service is unavailable. Try again later or open Releases.
ExplorerPinSetting: Show “Pin to ReStart” in File Explorer
ExplorerPinHelp: Adds one command for your Windows account. On Windows 11, choose Show more options. Turn this off before moving or deleting the portable app; launch from its new location to refresh the command.
ErrorPinPath: Choose an existing file or folder using its absolute path.
ErrorPinMissing: The selected file or folder no longer exists.
ErrorPinConnection: The running ReStart could not accept this pin. Restart ReStart and try again.
ErrorExplorerRegistration: Could not update the File Explorer command:
SystemMetricsHelp: Tiles requesting system.metrics can read aggregate CPU, memory, network rates, fixed-drive capacity, battery and uptime while Start is visible. Scripts cannot read files, process names or make network requests.
SlideshowFolderSaved: Slideshow folder selected. The tile will refresh shortly.
TileLibraryHelp: Put each package folder containing manifest.json and tile.js here. Available tiles appear automatically; click one to add an independent copy.
TileLibraryEmpty: No packages yet. Copy a tile package folder into the library.
StartupSearch: Type to search. Your query will be ready when Start opens.
